tools.name: smart_report_list_presets
tools.description: List Verifik system SmartReport presets (citizen, company, vehicle bundles across countries) along with their systemKey, credit cost estimate, and required input schema.

country.description: Optional ISO country filter (e.g. CO, MX, PE, US).

search.description: Optional text search across name, description, and systemKey.

tools.name: smart_report_clone_preset
tools.description: Clone a system SmartReport preset into a reusable client-owned BatchConfiguration and preferred PDF SmartReportTemplate (idempotent: reuses existing clone if present).

tools.name: smart_report_get_input_schema
tools.description: Get the exact required/optional input fields, JSON Schema, example input object, preferred template ID, and estimated per-row credit cost for a BatchConfiguration.

tools.name: smart_report_run
tools.description: Headless end-to-end SmartReport execution: resolves a saved BatchConfiguration or clones a systemKey preset, validates inputs, runs chained verification steps server-side (billing client credits), generates the PDF report + Verification Score, optionally emails recipients, and fires report webhooks.

systemKey.description: System preset key to clone/reuse when batchConfigurationId is omitted (e.g. co.citizen.comprehensive).

inputs.description: Single input object (e.g. {"documentType":"CC","documentNumber":"123"}) or array of up to 500 input rows.

mode.description: Execution mode. sync waits (up to 5 rows) and returns the finished report; async returns 202 Accepted immediately and notifies webhooks.

generatePdf.description: Set false to skip PDF generation and return structured batch + verification score only (default true).

includePdfBase64.description: Set true to inline base64 PDF bytes in the JSON response (default false; downloadUrl is always returned).

emailTo.description: Optional recipient email addresses to deliver the finished PDF (max 20).

webhookUrl.description: Optional per-run HTTPS webhook URL receiving smart_batch_report_generated / sent / batch_completed events.

externalRefId.description: Caller correlation ID persisted on the SmartReport and included in webhook events.

costCenter.description: Optional Cost Center (CECO) code or ID attributed to this run and forwarded as x-cost-center.

tools.name: smart_report_get
tools.description: Retrieve SmartReport status, metadata, Verification Score summary, email delivery history, and downloadUrl / htmlUrl.

tools.name: smart_report_get_html
tools.description: Fetch rendered HTML, structured row verification results, and Verification Score for an existing SmartReport without invoking PDF rendering.

preview.description: Include interactive screen preview wrapper styling.

tools.name: smart_report_generate_pdf
tools.description: Render (or regenerate) a PDF for an existing SmartReport record and emit smart_batch_report_generated webhooks.

rowIndex.description: Optional zero-based row index to render a single-subject PDF.

tools.name: smart_report_download_pdf
tools.description: Download the binary PDF of a SmartReport (MCP tool returns byte size, content-type, downloadUrl, and base64 only when includeBase64 is true).

includeBase64.description: Set true to include base64 PDF content in MCP output (default false).

tools.name: smart_report_send_email
tools.description: Send a generated SmartReport PDF via email to one or more recipients and trigger smart_batch_report_sent / delivery_failed webhooks.

rowIndex.description: Optional row index when sending a single record PDF.

sendAll.description: Send all rows (up to 50) as separate PDF attachments.

tools.name: smart_report_list_templates
tools.description: List available SmartReport templates owned by the authenticated client or built-in system templates.
